name: 13-maple-hollow-portrait
prompt:
Create ONE completed Midlife Survivors title-screen illustration, scene13, portrait. TALL VERTICAL9:16 canvas, EXACT1080x1920. Recompose this scene specifically for phone; do NOT make a landscape crop. ALL character bodies, faces, car and active props must lie within the single horizontal band y600-880 (31%-46% of image height), centered x60-1020. Make them readable and fill the band width, no tiny distant cast. The porch/garage opening and lower facade sit behind this band. The roof, treetops and pale sky above y580 are quiet and lower contrast; roof may extend above band but NO faces/people/car/action there. Below y900 is calm broad lawn, sidewalk and street with almost no high-contrast details. No important character or vehicle below880.
REFERENCE ROLES: First image is ONLY the composition mask: green is where visible action goes, dark is quiet environment. DO NOT PAINT the mask/rectangles/colors as a diagram. Second image is house/town design, NOT a panel layout, ignore its old noisy ground textures. Third is exact cast/prop identity, NOT a character collage. Fourth image is the real title UI guide, ONLY spatial reference; NEVER render UI, labels, buttons, borders, logos or any of its writing. Turn all this into ONE continuous believable suburban environment.
SCENE: Peak-fall Maple Hollow suburb. ONE9-to-5er hero crouches at the front step of his coffee-orange two-story house and lifts the doormat, searching under it. Big gray FAKE ROCK immediately beside the step has a tiny brass key peeking from underneath, obvious joke. He holds his orange coffee mug, looks puzzled; black rectangular glasses, messy brown hair gray temples, white short-sleeve shirt, loose russet-red tie, khaki trousers. His son in lavender hoodie works a SMALL striped lemonade stand beside the porch/sidewalk and waves at Dad. ONE stern gray-haired HOA Board President in teal cardigan/vest and lanyard bends over holding a wooden yardstick VERTICALLY into the grass, carefully measuring its height, frowning, clipboard under arm. A grumpy Leaf Pile monster peeks from a raked heap nearby; a small sage angry push-mower rolls in at right. Tiny blank Tax Notice envelopes may appear only at far edges. Warm funny, sunny home-is-its-own-boss-fight moment. Clear spatial grouping of Dad at door, kid at stand, HOA on lawn, no duplicates.
STYLE: crisp handmade16-bit pixel art with hard readable pixel clusters, slight top-down3/4 perspective matching the sprites. Clean broad flat color areas,2-3 hue-shifted tones per material,1px-equivalent navy outlines on objects, deliberate readable details. Bright grass in simple sage clumps, NO speckled grass/noise/dithering everywhere. Upper-left clear autumn light, contact shadows allowed, NEUTRAL WHITE BALANCE. Palette ONLY #171C35 #303750 #526078 #3E7775 #83A89A #D3B78D #F2D7A1 #FFF0CF #EF9347 #C45C4B #BFA8CF #F1B5BF. No sepia, golden haze or film tint. NO blur, antialiasing, realistic or3D rendering. No magenta areas.
Zero text, letters, numbers, logos, brands, license plates, signatures, readable signs or watermarks anywhere. Lemonade sign and house-number spots are BLANK. Trees/fall leaves may be coffee-orange/russet but do not tint the whole scene. Quiet areas remain visibly drawn, lower contrast, no vignette or faded photographic fog. Main action placement is the first priority.
